# pve_node_disk_initgpt (Action)

Initialize a disk with a fresh GPT (destructive).

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "pve_node_disk_initgpt" "example" {
  config {
  disk = "CHANGE_ME"
  node = "pve1"
  }
}

# terraform_data is a no-op stand-in; wire action.pve actions to the
# lifecycle events of any managed resource.
resource "terraform_data" "trigger" {
  lifecycle {
    action_trigger {
      events  = [after_create]
      actions = [action.pve_node_disk_initgpt.example]
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `disk` (String) Block device name
- `node` (String) The cluster node name.

### Optional

- `uuid` (String) UUID for the GPT table
